description: This Java source file defines the `ComponentConfig` class used in the Apache OFBiz framework. It models the configuration of components within OFBiz, including parsing associated XML configuration files, managing dependencies, resource locations, web applications, keystores, entity resources, service resources, and container configurations. It provides methods for retrieving component information, resource URLs, streams, and for managing component dependency sorting. It also defines several related inner classes representing resources, classpath info, webapp info, and other component-related entities.

classes.name: ComponentConfig
classes.description: Represents a component configuration loaded from the 'ofbiz-component.xml' file, including details like classpath, dependencies, resources, web applications, keystores, and container configurations.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing immutable ComponentConfig instances.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.ClasspathInfo
classes.description: Models the <classpath> XML element with location and type.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.ResourceInfo
classes.description: Abstract base class modeling resources associated with a component, providing methods for creating resource handlers and accessing resource locations.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.EntityResourceInfo
classes.description: Models the <entity-resource> XML element, with specific fields like type and reader name.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.KeystoreInfo
classes.description: Models the <keystore> XML element, encapsulating keystore metadata and providing access to the KeyStore object.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.ResourceLoaderInfo
classes.description: Models the <resource-loader> XML element, with properties such as name, type, environment variable, and prefix.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.ServiceResourceInfo
classes.description: Models the <service-resource> XML element, with a type attribute.

classes.name: ComponentConfig.WebappInfo
classes.description: Models the <webapp> XML element, encapsulating details like server, context root, mount point, permissions, and initialization parameters.

methods.name: componentExists
methods.description: Checks whether a component with the specified name exists in the cache.

methods.name: matchingComponentName
methods.description: Predicate to match components by name.

methods.name: getAllClasspathInfos
methods.description: Returns a list of all classpath information from all loaded components.

methods.name: getAllComponents
methods.description: Returns a collection of all cached component configurations.

methods.name: sortDependencies
methods.description: Sorts components based on their dependencies, throws `ComponentException` on invalid or cyclic dependencies.

methods.name: getAllConfigurations
methods.description: Gets all container configurations from all components.

methods.name: getAllEntityResourceInfos
methods.description: Returns list of entity resources filtered by type and optionally component name.

methods.name: getAllKeystoreInfos
methods.description: Returns all keystores from all components.

methods.name: getAllServiceResourceInfos
methods.description: Returns all service resources filtered by type.

methods.name: getAllTestSuiteInfos
methods.description: Returns test suites, optionally filtered by component name.

methods.name: getAllWebappResourceInfos
methods.description: Provides list of web applications across components.

methods.name: getComponentConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a component configuration by global name or root location, creating if necessary.

methods.name: getFullLocation
methods.description: Returns the full location of a resource within a component, combining resource loader info and location.

methods.name: getKeystoreInfo
methods.description: Finds a keystore by component name and keystore name.

methods.name: getRootLocation
methods.description: Returns the root location of the specified component.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Retrieves an InputStream for a resource within a component.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Gets the URL for a resource specified by resource loader name and location.

methods.name: getWebAppInfo
methods.description: Finds web app info by server name and context root.
